title: Early Diagnosis of Pulmonary Fibrosis - Diagnostic Delay
brief_summary: Patients with newly diagnosed IPF are investigated for the diagnostic delay before a diagnosis of IPF is made.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of IPF according to international guidelines

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide written informed consent
* Age below 18 years
study_population: All incident patients with IPF at Gentofte hospital and Aarhus university hospital.
